per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
Account_No must not be null
Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
Name must be in Title Case (allowing for lowercase particles like bin, binte, s/o, d/o)
ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one prefix letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by exactly 7 digits, and ending with one uppercase checksum letter
ID_No must match the corresponding ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
Gender must be either Male or Female
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
Age must be parseable as a numeric value
Contact_No must not be null
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number with 8 digits (starting with 6, 8, or 9), optionally prefixed with +65 or 65
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no spaces and valid local-part and domain structure
Country must represent Singapore (allowing for known variants: Singapore, SINGAPORE, singapore, S'pore, SG, Singapura, Republic of Singapore, 新加坡)
Street_Name must be in Title Case
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
Gender must be consistent with name particles: 'Bin' or 's/o' indicates Male; 'Binte' or 'd/o' indicates Female
S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty (one-to-one join key)
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
